map.基于FRAX模型评估10年主要骨质疏松性骨折和髋部骨折概率，辅助治疗决策: Estimate 10-year major osteoporotic and hip fracture probability from the FRAX model to support treatment decisions
map.核心计算公式（按输入变量）：min(100, (hipFxProb ÷ 30): Core formulas (by input): min(100, (hipFxProb ÷ 30) × 100); min(35, majorFxProb × 0.30); min(60, baseScore × 2.2)
map.📖 查看「骨质疏松(FRAX)骨折风险评估器 使用指南」: 📖 See the "Osteoporosis (FRAX) Fracture Risk Assessor User Guide"
map.生活方式干预，无需药物治疗: Lifestyle intervention, no drug treatment needed
map.考虑药物干预，个体化决策: Consider drug intervention, individualise the decision
map.髋部骨折概率≥3%或主要骨质疏松性骨折≥20%为药物干预阈值。FRAX使用股骨颈: A hip fracture probability ≥3% or a major osteoporotic fracture ≥20% is the drug-treatment threshold. FRAX is more accurate with femoral neck BMD; if no BMD is given the risk-factor calculation is unaffected (treated as no BMD).
map.📚 深度解析：骨质疏松(FRAX)骨折风险评估器: 📚 In-depth analysis: Osteoporosis (FRAX) Fracture Risk Assessor
map.绝经后女性骨密度 T 值处于骨量减少区间时，用 FRAX 做 10 年骨折风险分: Using FRAX to stratify 10-year fracture risk in postmenopausal women whose bone density T-score falls in the osteopenia range, to decide whether drug treatment is needed.
map.长期口服糖皮质激素（如泼尼松≥5 mg/日超过 3 个月）患者的骨折风险机会性筛: Opportunistic fracture risk screening in patients on long-term oral glucocorticoids (such as prednisone ≥5 mg/day for more than 3 months).
map.社区骨质疏松症高危人群（低体重、跌倒史、早绝经）的筛查与补钙/维生素 D 建议制: Screening community osteoporosis high-risk groups (low body weight, fall history, early menopause) and planning calcium/vitamin D advice.
map.24、既往脆性骨折 1 次、无父母髋骨折史、不吸烟、未用糖皮质激素、不饮酒。工具: 24, one previous fragility fracture, no parental hip fracture, non-smoker, no glucocorticoids, no alcohol. The tool returns the 10-year major osteoporotic and hip fracture probabilities and compares them with national intervention thresholds (such as ≥20% major or ≥3% hip) to suggest starting antiosteoporotic therapy alongside the BMD T-score.
map.适用于 40–90 岁、尚未接受抗骨质疏松治疗的人群；已治疗者结果会被低估。不能: It suits people aged 40-90 who have not started antiosteoporotic treatment; results are underestimated for those already treated. It does not replace bone density testing or overall clinical judgement.
map.FRAX 没包含跌倒因素，怎么用？: FRAX has no fall factor, so how should I use it?
map.FRAX 评估的是骨折内在骨强度风险，高跌倒风险者（老年、神经肌肉疾病）应结合临: FRAX measures the intrinsic bone-strength fracture risk; anyone at high fall risk (older adults, neuromuscular disease) needs separate clinical assessment, and results near the threshold favour acting earlier.
map.FRAX是WHO推荐的骨折风险评估工具，整合临床危险因素和BMD，评估10年骨折: FRAX is the fracture risk tool recommended by the WHO; it combines clinical risk factors with BMD to estimate 10-year fracture probability and support osteoporosis treatment decisions.
map.同步评估髋部和主要骨折: Hip and major fractures assessed together
